
LIST-FEATURES
List all feature files with optional filtering by tags

WHEN TO USE
  Use to see all features in your project, or filter by specific tags to find features in a particular phase, component, or priority level.

USAGE
  fspec list-features [options]

OPTIONS
  --tag <tag>
    Filter by tag (can be used multiple times, e.g., --tag=@critical --tag=@critical)
  --format <format>
    Output format: table (default), json, or simple

EXAMPLES
  1. List all features
  $ fspec list-features
  spec/features/login.feature
spec/features/signup.feature

Found 2 features

  2. List phase 1 features
  $ fspec list-features --tag=@critical
  spec/features/login.feature [@critical @authentication]

Found 1 feature

  3. List features with multiple tags
  $ fspec list-features --tag=@critical --tag=@critical
  spec/features/login.feature [@critical @critical @authentication]

Found 1 feature

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec show-feature
  fspec create-feature
  fspec list-tags
  fspec validate

NOTES
  • Searches spec/features/ directory
  • Multiple --tag flags filter with AND logic (feature must have all tags)
  • JSON format useful for tooling integration
